jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(K) inventory: Rochester-Stockbridge Unified District, a unified union district in the White River Valley Supervisory Union (member towns: Rochester, Stockbridge). Operates PK-6 in both towns; tuitions grades 7-12.
White River Valley Supervisory Union (official site).

sources.note: RSUD Warning for May 6, 2026 (official warning text, district legal notice): Art. 11 warns one Rochester 3-year seat, one Stockbridge 3-year seat, and "Stockbridge 1 director for the remainder of a one (1) year term" -- town-only electorates under the March 2021 articles amendment (the 2017 articles as adopted, AOE State Board Item P-1, set 3 Rochester + 3 Stockbridge residency seats elected district-wide; the signed May 7, 2024 warning, Art. 12, runs the same town-separate form).

Town of Stockbridge Annual Report 2025 (official), "2025 Town Officials - Elected," Term Through column: Wildt 2027, Meagher 2026, Bebo-Long 2027 (Rochester); Edgerton 2026, Budukiewicz 2027, Bessett 2027 (Stockbridge). The column CONFLICTS with the articles' one-seat-per-town-per-year stagger (two Rochester seats at 2027, none at 2028): only Wildt's 2027 is independently corroborated (re-elected May 2024), so Bebo-Long and Budukiewicz are minted with NO ends and the conflict flagged rather than smoothed. HELD: Edgerton and Meagher -- their published terms expired at the May 6, 2026 election and the certified returns were not fetched. Patrick Hudson (Stockbridge) was re-elected in May 2024 to 2027 and is gone by March 2026; his seat is the one warned for its 1-year remainder in May 2026 (his departure year is not tightly bracketed, so no ended record is minted).

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, town-only electorates under the March 2021 articles amendment). Two seats are held (Edgerton, Meagher -- see the sources).

directors.name: Joshua Budukiewicz

directors.name: Jesse Bessett
directors.note: Minted ELECTED under the appointment-to-election inference (the Marineau pattern): Patrick Hudson, re-elected May 2024 to 2027, departed mid-term; Bessett was seated with no election documented; Hudson's seat was then warned for election to its 1-year remainder at the May 6, 2026 annual meeting, and Bessett is still seated in September 2026 with no re-appointment documented. The appointment itself and the May 2026 outcome rest on the warning signatories and the Stockbridge report roster, flagged here.
